sentences.template: Recent years have seen targeted government measures to promote {{A}}, an initiative that continues to {{具体扣题}}.

sentences.category: 原因 / 政策 / 体系缺失
sentences.title: 供给不足与需求忽视
sentences.template: {{A}} often fall short of providing {{B}} regarding {{C}}. At its heart lies a dearth of attention to the genuine demands of {{sb}}.

sentences.template: Pervasive media coverage sheds light on {{social issues}}, reshaping public perceptions and naturally translating heightened awareness into {{具体行动}}.
sentences.notes: 结尾示例：concrete action；或落实到具体行动，结合题目填写。

sentences.category: 原因 / 意识 / 环保等
sentences.title: 意识觉醒与责任
sentences.template: As the public wakes up to {{A}} concerns, individuals attach paramount importance to {{B}}, reconsidering how everyday choices affect {{A变式或具体行动}}.
sentences.notes: A：ecological（生态）；B：environmental responsibility（环保责任）；A变式：nature（自然）。

sentences.category: 原因 / 文化 / 开放与认同
sentences.title: 文化活力与认同
sentences.template: China's vibrant and ever-evolving culture of {{文化内容}} naturally empowers {{sb}} to {{文化行动}}.
sentences.notes: 文化行动选项：embrace cultural diversity / preserve traditional heritage。

words.term: an obsession with the huge profits they reap
words.meaning: 对所获巨额利润的痴迷

sourceText:
原因

通用句式

正向驱动：Driven by [A], [B]... / ...naturally translates into...
动作赋能：..., empowering sb to [do sth]
深层归因：...stems from [A], coupled with [B]. At its heart lies [C]
揭示/强调：Particularly paramount is [A] / ...sheds light on [B]

1. 个体

家长：期待
A growing number of households attach paramount importance to A, which naturally translates into persistent encouragement for children to [do sth].

同辈：压力
Swept up in a cut-throat environment, individuals are relentlessly empowered by peer pressure to [do sth].

个人
优点
Particularly paramount is …, which empowers individuals to weather setbacks and sustain their efforts despite delayed gratification.
eg. perseverance

A offers emotional resilience when difficulties arise, rendering daunting challenges far easier to confront.
A：Mutual support相互支持

缺点
People are inherently wired to prioritize A over B, which helps explain their reluctance to do sth.
A：immediate gratification 即时满足
B：lasting benefits长远益处
do sth：undertake demanding tasks承担有难度的任务

Their improper conduct stems from A, coupled with B.
A：selfishness自私
B：an obsession with the huge profits they reap对所获巨额利润的痴迷

2. 经济：收入与消费能力
Purchasing power has ceased to be a major bottleneck to consumption, as China enjoys robust economic momentum that elevates disposable incomes, empowering consumers to afford A previously beyond their reach.

3. 政策
公共投入
Recent years have seen targeted government measures to promote A, an initiative that continues to benefit sb / improve sth /具体扣题

体系缺失
A often fall short of providing B regarding C. At its heart lies a dearth of attention to the genuine demands of sb.

4. 科技：平台与资源可及性
China is riding the wave of technological innovation, where the ripple effects of [A] have empowered us to transcend spatial constraints and reshape the way we [do sth].

5. 传播：媒介与价值塑造
Pervasive media coverage sheds light on [social issues], reshaping public perceptions and naturally translating heightened awareness into concrete action/落实到具体行动（扣题）.

6. 意识（eg.环保）
As the public wakes up to [A concerns] , individuals attach paramount importance to B, reconsidering how everyday choices affect A变式 / 落实到具体行动（扣题）.
A：ecological生态
B：environmental responsibility环保责任
A变式：nature自然

7. 文化：开放与认同
China's vibrant and ever-evolving culture of...naturally empowers sb to [embrace cultural diversity / preserve traditional heritage].
